ideas.title: The Feeding Our Future Scandal: A Deep Dive into Minnesota's $250 Million Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the details of the Feeding Our Future scandal, including the individuals and organizations involved, and the impact on Minnesota's childcare assistance program.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and examine the systemic failures that allowed the fraud to occur
questions: Who were the key players involved?
What are the implications for similar programs nationwide?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and shed light on vulnerabilities in national programs. It's a high-priority investigation that could lead to significant reforms.

ideas.title: The Chilling Effect of Death Threats on Investigative Journalism
ideas.description: Explore the impact of death threats on journalists investigating similar cases, including the Minnesota fraud scandal.
ideas.angle: Examine the broader implications for investigative reporting and the role of journalists in uncovering corruption
questions: What are the effects of death threats on journalists?
What are the implications for investigative reporting?
ideas.insight: This story highlights the risks journalists take when investigating corruption and the importance of protecting their rights and safety.
